entries.text: The selected examples suggest a preacher who develops explanations through textual comparison and contrasting accounts, then gives ideas a concrete setting through an anecdote and a practical application.
entries.rationale: The reviewed examples separately show Gospel comparison, a contrasted account of final destiny, a remembered encounter and a move toward public communication. The connection is an authored account of this repertoire.
entries.limits: These are separately chosen examples across three recordings, not a connected sermon outline, dominant style or frequency estimate.
entries.alternative: Selecting high stored treatment candidates makes varied methods more visible than a representative sample might.
entries.review_status: Codex manually authored interpretation; Brian reader acceptance pending

entries.text: A potential strength of this repertoire is that textual detail sits alongside concrete situations a reader can picture; whether this helps listeners understand or act remains unknown.
entries.rationale: The Gospel comparison offers textual detail; the encounter and application examples provide concrete situations. Their possible accessibility is an interpretive possibility, not an observed audience benefit.
entries.limits: The examples occur in separate passages. Audience comprehension, persuasion and response were not measured.
entries.alternative: These isolated examples may overstate how consistently detailed explanation and concrete illustration work together.
entries.review_status: Codex manually authored interpretation; Brian reader acceptance pending

entries.text: A useful question is how well the conclusions drawn from the compared Gospel accounts and competing accounts of final destiny hold up when their assumptions and full qualifications are examined.
entries.rationale: Both reviewed examples move through interpretive reasoning. That makes the warrant for their conclusions a concrete subject for review, without asserting that either is mistaken.
entries.limits: This is a review question, not a detected doctrinal error or contradiction. Adopted positions and attached qualifications remain unbound.
entries.alternative: The complete surrounding argument may already answer the question; these selected blocks do not establish a deficiency.
